summary: Final run: score data/heldout.csv once with the tuned kernel logistic, write cv_auc, holdout_auc, gap
reasoning: The tuned kernel logistic procedure reaches nested cv_auc 0.8678 on pilot (my step-18 run against plan step-17), built on the 0.6313 additive baseline of the pairs trail. Nothing in the design has changed since the pilot-only estimate, and the plateau was seed-stable, so the held-out AUC should land near 0.86-0.87: I expect holdout_auc >= 0.80 with |gap| = |cv - holdout| well inside 0.05.
